tools.name: list_repositories
tools.title: List analyzed repositories
tools.description: Repositories this user has analyzed in Nykst, with the time of the latest analysis.

tools.name: get_architecture
tools.title: Get architecture overview
tools.description: Overview of a repository's structure from its import graph: top-level areas, external services (with evidence), database tables/functions/models, most depended-on files, circular imports and known blind spots. Call this first when you need orientation in an unfamiliar codebase.

repository.description: owner/name of an analyzed repository. Defaults to the most recently analyzed one.

tools.name: get_impact
tools.title: What breaks if I change this?
tools.description: Before editing, pass the file paths (or a directory) you plan to change. Returns every file that imports them directly or transitively with the exact import lines, affected page/API entry points with their import chains, tests that cover them, files that historically change together with them, and recent commits/PRs.

paths.description: Repository-relative file paths or directory prefixes, e.g. ["src/lib/auth.ts"] or ["src/lib/billing/"].

repository.description: owner/name of an analyzed repository. Defaults to the most recently analyzed one.

tools.name: find_usages
tools.title: Find usages of a table, service or env var
tools.description: Every file and line that touches a database table/RPC/model, an external service (e.g. supabase, stripe, github) or an environment variable, plus the combined impact of changing it.

table.description: Table, RPC function or ORM model name, e.g. "users".

service.description: Service id or name, e.g. "supabase" or "Stripe".

repository.description: owner/name of an analyzed repository. Defaults to the most recently analyzed one.

tools.name: search_files
tools.title: Search files and exports
tools.description: Find analyzed files whose path or exported symbol names contain the query.

repository.description: owner/name of an analyzed repository. Defaults to the most recently analyzed one.

tools.name: search_memory
tools.title: Search evidence memory
tools.description: Search cited memory extracted from ADRs, Mermaid diagrams, SQL migrations and image references. Every result carries a file citation and a checksum; nothing is model-generated.

repository.description: owner/name of an analyzed repository. Defaults to the most recently analyzed one.

tools.name: get_federation
tools.title: Federate OpenAPI and gRPC contracts
tools.description: Match provider OpenAPI operations and gRPC methods across every analyzed repository against literal consumer routes in the graph. Returns cross-repository edges, unmatched endpoints and honest contract limitations.

repository.description: owner/name of an analyzed repository. Defaults to the most recently analyzed one.

tools.name: simulate_change
tools.title: Simulate a change before writing it
tools.description: Apply file writes or deletions to an in-memory graph overlay and return the blast radius, new cycles, newly unresolved imports and SQL column drift. Nothing is persisted; the stored snapshot is never modified.

content.description: New file content, or null to simulate deletion.

changes.description: At most 50 file writes or deletions to overlay.

paths.description: Optional paths to measure; defaults to the changed paths.

repository.description: owner/name of an analyzed repository. Defaults to the most recently analyzed one.

tools.name: generate_fix_patch
tools.title: Generate a verified fix diff
tools.description: Deterministically remediate four breakage classes on an in-memory clone: unresolved import rewrites, arity and restored-export compatibility shims, runtime cycle conversion to `import type`, and SQL column drift renames. A unified diff is returned only when the verified breaking score falls without adding cycles. Pass the current file content.

content.description: Current file content, used to build and verify the exact diff.

issue.description: Optional remediation class. `auto` (default) evaluates all four deterministic strategies.

repository.description: owner/name of an analyzed repository. Defaults to the most recently analyzed one.

tools.name: run_safe_code_loop
tools.title: Check a proposed file with the safe coding loop
tools.description: Run the four-stage in-memory loop over a complete proposed file: bounded architecture and six-layer memory, AST call-site verification (scope, overloads, namespace calls, barrel re-exports), a deterministic verdict, Trinity root-cause cards with causal chains, and a verified four-strategy auto-heal. Nothing is written; a clean overlay is not a substitute for a full typecheck and test run.

repository.description: owner/name of an analyzed repository. Defaults to the most recently analyzed one.

tools.name: get_trace_overlay
tools.title: Overlay OpenTelemetry spans on the graph
tools.description: Attach OTLP JSON spans to analyzed files by code.filepath, then mark observed caller-callee edges that also exist in the static import graph. Unmatched spans are reported, never guessed. Read-only.

spans.description: OTLP JSON export ({ resourceSpans: [...] }) or a flat span array.

repository.description: owner/name of an analyzed repository. Defaults to the most recently analyzed one.
